[measurement]{.chip .measured} Entry 45 · milestone M4

The owner approved synchronization of the reviewed MAST-U refresh artifacts to
private tracking storage. We compared the pending payload with its approved
manifest before sending it with one worker. The offline payload queue is now empty.

We checked the remote folder and visibility, then downloaded every artifact and
compared its size and SHA-256 checksum with the manifest: [all 26 uploaded artifact records covering 18 distinct files match both remote SHA-256 metadata and downloaded bytes; the folder and private visibility match the approved request, and the offline payload queue is empty]{.claim}[C-184](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-184){.cid .st-measured}.
Public and tenant-wide visibility are disabled.

| verification | result |
|---|---|
| remote metadata and downloaded bytes | [all 26 uploaded artifact records covering 18 distinct files match both remote SHA-256 metadata and downloaded bytes; the folder and private visibility match the approved request, and the offline payload queue is empty]{.claim}[C-184](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-184){.cid .st-measured} |
| next physics check | training and coupled revalidation remain pending |

The upload contains duplicate provenance sidecar records from the existing tracking
workflow. Retrieval by name is ambiguous for those records. We downloaded each by
its artifact identifier and checked every record. The remote records remain intact.

This completes tracking for the approved label collection. It establishes artifact
integrity and private storage; it does not establish an improved surrogate or a
successful coupled remedy. The MAST-U closed-loop failure remains open ([K-030](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/ceilings.qmd#k-030)).

**What's next.** Prepare training and validation using the refreshed labels, preserving
the test split and the required monotonicity constraint. Model changes and another
coupled comparison remain separate work.
